content.short: Bizzllet helps manage business crypto payments, expenses and invoices.
content.description: Bizzllet is a self‑custody multisig business wallet that simplifies day‑to‑day crypto operations for teams. It supports multi‑chain wallets, supports collaborative workflows, and allows configurable role‑based rules to govern invoicing, payments, and expenses. Powered by Account Abstraction (AA) and Multi‑Party Computation (MPC), it keeps users in full control of their assets while reducing risk through distributed key sharing among team members and Bizzllet.
content.meta: Bizzllet is a self-custody multisig business wallet that helps manage daily crypto operations. Discover Bizzllet and other Web3 Wallets on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
